I'm a doctoral researcher in Heidelberg working on climate–health
epidemiology and spatial statistics. My methods sit mostly in Bayesian
spatiotemporal modeling — R-INLA, BYM2, CAR priors — alongside causal
inference (Mendelian randomization) and NLP on geotagged data.

Before this I trained as a dentist and earned master's degrees in public
health/epidemiology and in health informatics. I've published 32+ papers
(10,000+ citations), including work in *The Lancet Planetary Health* and
two first-author papers in *iScience* (Cell Press). These days I split my
attention between academic research and real-world evidence / HEOR.

## Research interests

- Bayesian spatiotemporal modeling (R-INLA, BYM2, CAR)
- Causal inference (Mendelian randomization, propensity scores, IPW, MSM)
- NLP & sentiment analysis on large geotagged datasets
- Real-world evidence & HEOR
- Reproducible analysis pipelines

## Tools

R · Python · R-INLA · high-performance computing · reproducible workflows
(renv / uv, Quarto, Make)
